test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Find the mean of the following distribution.

 
 

 
 
**x:**

 
 
 
5

 
 
 
6

 
 
 
7

 
 
 
8

 
 
 
9

 
 
 

 
 
**f:**

 
 
 
4

 
 
 
8

 
 
 
14

 
 
 
11

 
 
 
3
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2d76215b305380358dd69551779b4e33e710585ef8bd2fa1306e2a314a6e06c.png] 

**Formula used:**

∑ f = N 

By Direct Method:

Mean = ∑ fx/N 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46906fc311d766d05938e12909a30cdaef0f01421000fe7f4e57bd2c829341af.png] 

∑ f = N = 4 + 8 + 14 + 11 + 3 = 40

∑ fx = 20 + 48 + 98 + 88 + 27 = 281 

∴ Mean = 281/40 

**⇒ 7.025**
